Makita DGA452Z 18V Li-Ion LXT 4 1/2" cordless angle grinder delivers professional power for demanding cutting and grinding tasks on site. The versatile power tool is ideal for cord-free use during metal fabrication, plumbing installations, and general construction, and delivers 10,000 rpm no-load speed for rapid material removal. Features robust overload protection and accidental start protection for enhanced safety during operation. Powered by existing Makita 18V LXT batteries (sold separately). The durable magnesium alloy gearbox housing, fan-cooled motor, and dust-sealed bearings ensure long-term reliability and performance in tough workshop and site conditions.
b: High 10,000rpm No-Load Speed For Rapid Work
Does Not Include Battery or Charger
